description: Author estimates on LIVE's Elo-like scale, based on the statements and solution requirements, not a paper-position formula. LIVE values take precedence when later published. Shared 2026 AMC 10/12 problems receive identical estimates. The 2026 AMC 10A estimates were reviewed problem by problem on 2026-11-11 after the owner sat the paper: #25 came down sharply and #8, #16, #18, #20 and #21 moved.

2026 AMC 10A, Problem 2: Recognize that the tax share uses the total as denominator.
2026 AMC 10A, Problem 3: Similarity locates the diagonal intersection; shared-height areas finish.
2026 AMC 10A, Problem 4: Average interior or signed exterior angles, including reflex angles.
2026 AMC 10A, Problem 5: Recognize that appending the current mean leaves it fixed.
2026 AMC 10A, Problem 6: Recognize a right triangle and diameter, then subtract area from a semicircle.
2026 AMC 10A, Problem 7: Subtract linear equations and count positive splits.
2026 AMC 10A, Problem 8: Take the favourable rounding endpoint of both the distance and the time, read 'possibly allow' correctly, and convert minutes to hours; the wording costs more solvers than the arithmetic.
2026 AMC 10A, Problem 9: Match unequal corresponding sides of similar triangles without assuming the labels match.
2026 AMC 10A, Problem 10: Combine the sum of squares with the median and solve the resulting ratio.
2026 AMC 10A, Problem 11: Separate the cases where the LCM is the fixed number or the unknown.
2026 AMC 10A, Problem 12: Reverse the stopping event into constraints on the final three socks.
2026 AMC 10A, Problem 13: Total handshakes determine the sum; cross-club handshakes determine the product.
2026 AMC 10A, Problem 14: Intersect all three quadratic triangle inequalities and enforce positivity.
2026 AMC 10A, Problem 15: Find the inverse tree rule and run a subtractive Euclidean process.
2026 AMC 10A, Problem 16: First minimize the capped score, then count the four extremal colour patterns; short once the minimum of 4 is found.
2026 AMC 10A, Problem 17: Recognize the intersection as a smaller regular hexagon through inward distances.
2026 AMC 10A, Problem 18: Shift an affine recurrence to its fixed point, then use integrality and strict decrease across ten halvings.
2026 AMC 10A, Problem 19: Project a hemisphere-covering problem and balance extreme corner distances.
2026 AMC 10A, Problem 20: Squarefree factorization into three factors: onto assignments of seven primes by inclusion-exclusion, divided by six because the sides are distinct.
2026 AMC 10A, Problem 21: Only ten connected-triomino partitions exist, and a win forces the four X's to split two and two.
2026 AMC 10A, Problem 22: An affine stretch turns ellipse tangency into circle-center geometry.
2026 AMC 10A, Problem 23: Classify attainable count pairs by residues and handle the bounded endpoint cases.
2026 AMC 10A, Problem 24: Divide a conjugate-value difference and count bounded integer coefficients.
2026 AMC 10A, Problem 25: A total-count equation and the bound from the room that starts with one nut give 95 at once; the feasibility schedule is not needed to choose the answer. Rated well below a usual last question after the owner sat the paper (2026-11-11).
2026 AMC 12A, Problem 7: Square the conjugate complex bases and use the cycle of powers of i.
2026 AMC 12A, Problem 8: Convert unequal group percentages into a linear minimization with bounds.
2026 AMC 12A, Problem 9: Keep the zero-factor branch and the denominator restriction while counting roots.
2026 AMC 12A, Problem 12: Recognize a covering of all residue classes through the complement.
2026 AMC 12A, Problem 13: Uniform random placements and distinct rolls reduce to one increasing order.
2026 AMC 12A, Problem 14: Match a rotated box's ordered dimensions with the interior dimensions.
2026 AMC 12A, Problem 15: Use a trigonometric product identity, then bound a logarithm's floor.
2026 AMC 12A, Problem 18: Translate three section radii into squared distances to perpendicular planes.
2026 AMC 12A, Problem 19: Factor a trigonometric sum and count all distinct branches.
2026 AMC 12A, Problem 21: Translate six area lower bounds into a homothetic hexagon and an area ratio.
2026 AMC 12A, Problem 22: Build and evaluate an ordered unary/binary-tree convolution recurrence.
2026 AMC 12A, Problem 23: Telescope an infinite product and invert an algebraic number modulo its cubic.
2026 AMC 12A, Problem 24: Model two corner-circle radii and external tangency, then select the feasible root.
2026 AMC 12A, Problem 25: Combine prime-power root counts, CRT and a minimal-product comparison.
2019 HMMT February Geometry, Problem 1: A sharp quadrilateral angle bound requires both a counting argument and a limiting example.
2019 HMMT February Geometry, Problem 2: Equal-area pieces reveal a ratio; perpendicular lines then force special-triangle similarity.
2019 HMMT February Geometry, Problem 3: Identify the envelope of a family of circles and decompose its tangent-bounded region.
2019 HMMT February Geometry, Problem 4: Exploit two parallelogram symmetries, similar triangles and two admissible area-ratio roots.
2019 HMMT February Geometry, Problem 5: A reflection reveals a tangent; chord geometry then requires recognizing the two positions.
2019 HMMT February Geometry, Problem 6: Find and bound both extremal enclosing-circle configurations for a closed chain of disks.
2019 HMMT February Geometry, Problem 7: Recognize equal reflected circumcircles and an anticomplementary-triangle homothety.
2019 HMMT February Geometry, Problem 8: Combine orthocenter/circumcenter coordinates with the perimeter's ellipse.
2019 HMMT February Geometry, Problem 9: Constrain an oblique plane by equal edges, solve its section and recover area from projection.
2019 HMMT February Geometry, Problem 10: Track repeated external-square constructions and multiple polygon-area contributions.
